name: Penalty Financial Instrument Identification 1
definition: Specifies the details of the financial instrument subject to penalties.

SubjectToPenalties.name: Subject To Penalties
SubjectToPenalties.definition: Indicates if the financial instrument is subject to penalties on this business day.||Usage: If not provided it means that the security is subject to penalties on this business day.

ClassificationType.name: Classification Type
ClassificationType.definition: Classification type of the financial instrument, as per the ISO Classification of Financial Instrument (CFI) codification, for example, common share with voting rights, fully paid, or registered.

Liquidity.name: Liquidity
Liquidity.definition: Specifies whether the security is liquid or illiquid.||Usage: When indicator in not provided, the liquidity is not relevant.

PriceData.name: Price Data
PriceData.definition: Further details on the price of the financial instrument.

ForeignExchangeData.name: Foreign Exchange Data
ForeignExchangeData.definition: Further details on the foreign exchange rate.

SecuritiesPenaltyRateData.name: Securities Penalty Rate Data
SecuritiesPenaltyRateData.definition: Penalty rate data provided if the securities is subject to penalties and the calculation method code is securities or both.
